summary: Computes a widget's output bounding rectangle into four caller-supplied output pointers a2/a3/a4/a5. When the widget's 16-bit height (this+0x28) is not greater than 0 or its 16-bit width (this+0x2A) is not greater than 0, copies the raw dword rectangle at this+0x4/this+0x8/this+0xC/this+0x10 straight through. Otherwise computes the pixel-accurate bounds from the 16-bit start coordinates and extents: left = this+0x26, right = this+0x26 + this+0x2A - 1, top = this+0x24, bottom = this+0x24 + this+0x28 - 1. Returns the a4 output pointer.

local_names.this: widget whose bounding rectangle is computed
local_names.result: a4 output pointer returned by the function

operations.description: Guards on the 16-bit dimensions: when height this+0x28 is less than or equal to 0, or width this+0x2A is less than or equal to 0, the widget has no valid pixel size and the raw dword rectangle is emitted instead
Raw fallback path: writes the dword rectangle this+0x4/this+0x8/this+0xC/this+0x10 to the four outputs a2/a3/a4/a5
Computed path: a2 = this+0x26 (left start), a3 = this+0x26 + this+0x2A - 1 (right end), a4 = this+0x24 (top start), a5 = this+0x24 + this+0x28 - 1 (bottom end), all 16-bit values
Returns the a4 output pointer from both paths
